DGFT Opens Recruitment for 2 Young Professional Positions in Panipat: Check Details

The Office of the Joint Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) in Panipat, functioning under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, has announced an open recruitment drive for two Young Professional positions. The temporary roles focus on policy formulation and the execution of schemes under India's Foreign Trade Policy.

Applications are currently being accepted from qualified individuals who meet the prescribed academic and age criteria. Candidates interested in applying should review the official guidelines and submit their documentation prior to the designated deadline.

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

Applicants are required to possess a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized university in a Master’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, or Law, or hold a B.Tech, B.E., or MCA degree. Preference will be given to candidates who possess professional experience in Foreign Trade, Public Policy, or Management, alongside verified proficiency in computer applications such as MS Word, Excel, and Data Analytics.

Age limitations dictate that candidates must not exceed 35 years of age as of 14 October 2026. Proof of age and date of birth must be established using a matriculation certificate.

Remuneration and Tenure

Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly fee of Rs. 52,000, subject to applicable Professional Tax or Tax Deducted at Source (TDS). The compensation is released once the controlling officer certifies the completion of assigned work for the period. No additional allowances or facilities are provided, though official travel (TA/DA) is reimbursed at par with an Assistant Section Officer of the Central Government.

Appointments are temporary, structured for an initial duration of one year. Contracts may be extended up to a maximum of three years based on performance and operational requirements, but cannot exceed the three-year limit under any circumstances.

Application Procedure and Selection Process

Interested applicants must fill out the prescribed application proforma, attach self-attested copies of supporting academic and experience documents, include a copy of their matriculation certificate, and submit a resume. The completed application package can be sent via email to the official designated address with the subject line formatted as "Application for Young Professional - [Your Name]", and/or dispatched by post to the Office of the Joint Director General of Foreign Trade, BSNL CSC Building, Near Police Station, G.T. Road, Panipat - 132103.

The final deadline for receiving applications is 31 October 2026. Incomplete submissions or those arriving after the deadline will be rejected. Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding a written test or interview. Successful applicants will also be required to provide a police verification report, a medical fitness certificate, and sign a non-disclosure and non-compete agreement prior to joining.

Practical Implications and Verification Guide

Readers evaluating this announcement should note the following operational details:

  • Confirmed Facts: Two vacancies exist at the DGFT Panipat office with a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs. 52,000, a maximum age ceiling of 35 years, and an application deadline of 31 October 2026.
  • Unknowns: The specific distribution of vacancies across disciplines and the exact dates for the written test or interview have not been disclosed in the initial notification.
  • Verification: Applicants should cross-reference all forms, qualification requirements, and submission formats directly against the official notice hosted on the source platform at [FreeJobAlert DGFT Recruitment 2026](https://www.freejobalert.com/articles/dgft-young-professional-recruitment-2026-apply-online-for-2-posts-3075089).
